Tap corners, then Finish

longText.text: Kwamani khuḓa, ni kone u nanga Fhedzisani
Tap corners, then Finish
Maipfi aya a Tshivenḓa ndi mvetamveto ya mutshini i sa athu ṱolwa.
The Tshivenda wording on this page is an unreviewed machine draft. Read the English before relying on it for a farming or account decision.
Ḓuvha ḽi na maanḓa nga maanḓa u bva DEVHULA — vheani mibethe yaṋu kha sia ḽeneḽo.
Sun: strongest from the NORTH — put your beds on that side.
Ndinganyelo ya giridi ya kilima kha khoudinethe idzi: muya U BVA vhubvaḓuvha tshilimo, devhula-vhukovhela vhuriha. Khwaṱhisedzani fhethu.
Coordinate climate-grid mean: wind FROM the east in summer, north-west in winter. Confirm on site.
Maḓi a elela a tshi tsela devhula — migero ya u fara maḓi i PFUKA u elela honoho · ṅwando u dzula fhasi henefho nga vhusiku vhu rotholelaho vhu si na muya.
Water flows downhill to the north — swales go ACROSS that flow · frost settles low there on still, cold nights.

Ḓuvha ḽi na maanḓa nga maanḓa u bva DEVHULA VHURIHA, TSHIPEMBE TSHILIMO — vheani mibethe yaṋu kha sia ḽeneḽo.
Sun: strongest from the NORTH IN WINTER, SOUTH IN SUMMER — put your beds on that side.
No regional fire-wind pattern for this area — walk the boundary and ask neighbours which side fires come from.
Maipfi aya a Tshivenḓa ndi mvetamveto ya mutshini i sa athu ṱolwa.
The Tshivenda wording on this page is an unreviewed machine draft. Read the English before relying on it for a farming or account decision.
Vulani fhethu afha kha mapa u thoma uri ni vhale maanḓa aho.
Fananyisani lushaka lwa tshimela u ya nga kilima ya fhethu honoho; iledzani ṅwando muhulwane na mavu a sa bvumisaho maḓi zwavhuḓi.
Fananyisani tshilimo tshi dudelaho na vhuriha vhu rotholelaho vhu si na ṅwando uri hu vhe na maluvha; tsireledzani kha muya ni sheledze zwimela zwiṱuku.
Fananyisani lushaka lwa tsimu ya nḓirivhe na dzingu ḽa u bveledza, maḓi na maitele a u tikedza. Tshifhinga tsha mphakelo wa lushaka tshi ṱanganya madzingu manzhi.
Shumisani matavhi a navhaho o kunaho ni fananyise lushaka na maitele a u bveledza na fhethu. U sheledza hu fulufhedzeaho na u langa malwadze ndi zwa ndeme.
Fananyisani u rothola na tshaka dzi tshimbidzanaho kha luvhanda. Lushaka lwa vhuvhili lu tea u vha na maluvha nga tshifhinga tshi tshimbidzanaho, hu si u sokou vhibva nga tshifhinga tsho fhambanaho.
Fananyisani na vhudzulo ha henefho ha mavhiḓa/ḓaka ḽi re na matombo; maḓuvha a maluvha a si maḓuvha a khaṋo.
